# decodeHtml

<link-summary>Turns numeric character references back into characters.</link-summary>

<web-summary>decodeHtml() — Turns numeric character references back into characters. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>html</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function decodeHtml(value: string): string;
```

Decimal (`&#60;`) and hexadecimal (`&#x3C;`) references are decoded. Named entities are **not**: `"&amp;"` comes back unchanged, because this is the inverse of `encodeHtml`, which only ever emits numeric references.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                  |
| :-------- | :------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| `value`   | `string` | The string to convert. It must not be empty. |

## Returns

`string` — the decoded string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
decodeHtml("&#60;a&#62;"); // => "<a>"
decodeHtml("&amp;"); // => "&amp;"
```
